//: Typecheck + editor config for @continuum/web. Mirrors the SDK's strict contract (target/module/resolution/lib) because this app compiles against the SDK source (@continuum/sdk-typescript resolves to ./index.ts, no build step). vite owns the actual bundle (npm run build = vite build), so no emit here — tsc is `--noEmit` typecheck only, hence no declaration/outDir/rootDir. DOM lib is load-bearing: this is the one client tier that touches document/WebSocket.
